evidence: Lighthouse reports: 'Image elements do not have [alt] attributes'. The expanded audit lists multiple failing elements.
user_impact: Screen-reader users may not receive the purpose or content of informative images.
recommended_fix: Add concise, meaningful alt text to informative images. Use alt="" for decorative images.

evidence: Lighthouse reports: 'Select elements do not have associated label elements.'
user_impact: Users of assistive technology may not understand the purpose of the select control.
recommended_fix: Associate each select control with a visible <label>, or provide an appropriate accessible name.

evidence: Lighthouse reports: 'Links do not have a discernible name.'
user_impact: Screen-reader users may be unable to determine the purpose of affected links.
recommended_fix: Give every meaningful link an accessible, descriptive name using visible text or an appropriate accessible label.

evidence: Lighthouse reports: 'Background and foreground colors do not have a sufficient contrast ratio.'
user_impact: Users with low vision or color-vision limitations may have difficulty reading affected content.
recommended_fix: Adjust foreground/background color combinations to meet the applicable WCAG contrast ratio.

evidence: Lighthouse reports: '<html> element does not have a [lang] attribute.'
user_impact: Assistive technologies may not reliably determine the page's default language.
recommended_fix: Add the appropriate language attribute to the root element, for example <html lang="en">.
